label: Diagram 19
caption: Diagram 19 Heights and arrangement of fittings in a unisex wheelchair-accessible toilet (looking towards wall A in diagram 18)
description:
This drawing is a diagram showing the heights and arrangement of fittings in a unisex wheelchair-accessible toilet, looking towards wall A.

The diagram shows a rectangular wall area with various fittings. On the left, a 'Shelf' is positioned with a dimension of '720-740mm' from the floor. Above this, a 'Sanitary dispenser with coin slot' is indicated to be 'between 750mm and 1000mm above the floor'.

The center of the wall features several items: a 'HD' (possible position for automatic hand dryer), 'SD' (soap dispenser), 'PT' (paper towel dispenser), 'TP' (toilet paper dispenser), and 'AR' (alarm reset button). These are arranged horizontally. A 'Grab rails' symbol is shown near the shelf and another below the dispensers. An 'Alarm pull cord with two red bangles' is indicated, with one bangle 'at 100mm' and the other 'at 800mm to 1000mm above floor level'.

Dimensions provided include '480mm' between the shelf and the soap dispenser, '300mm' height for the dispensers/shelf area, and '1100mm' and '680mm' vertical measurements on the right. A 'Disposal bin' is located at the bottom left.
